title: Fireify
body:
This is F!RE

A fun mod where you can use custom flaming items made from Fire charges.

And theres a pickaxe that is basicly a netherite pickaxe but be carful not to RIGHT CLICK!
![Pickaxe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/63fc0922c5cd1ebbbab1836680f35e6f5f6af44d.png)

This sword looks weak but don't judge a book by its cover.
![Sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3683cf0aa4e8422bf806bcceca1a2cb0fa7930f6.png)


AND MORE LIKE A FLAMING AXE, SHOVEL AND HOE
